readExpr: (() => { const keys = ['crud:mem:imported:ok','crud:mem:ttltrap']; let n = 0; for (const k of keys) { const tr = document.querySelector('tr[data-key="'+btoa(k)+'"]'); if (tr) { const cb = tr.querySelector('.check-key'); cb.checked = true; cb.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); n++; } } return 'checked ' + n; })()
